name: confluence-cloud-mcp
description: Search, read, navigate, and update Confluence Cloud through a local MCP server.
long_description: A local stdio MCP server for Confluence Cloud REST API v1 and v2. Credentials are collected through Claude Desktop's secure extension configuration and are passed only as environment variables to the server.

base_url.title: Confluence site URL
base_url.description: HTTPS site URL without /wiki, for example https://example.atlassian.net

email.title: Atlassian email
email.description: Email address associated with the Atlassian API token

allow_destructive_operations.title: Enable destructive operations
allow_destructive_operations.description: Allows delete and purge tools, which still require confirm=true.

allow_raw_write.title: Enable raw write requests
allow_raw_write.description: Allows non-GET raw requests, which still require confirm=true.

allow_local_file_upload.title: Enable local file upload
allow_local_file_upload.description: Allows the attachment tool to read a local file after confirm=true.
